patch_description: This version retains the successful joint center-and-radius SLSQP formulation, but improves the crossover by using several complementary feasible seeds: a dense 5-by-5 core with a corner defect, staggered layered hexagonal-style layouts, and an asymmetric alternating-row seed. Constraints and Jacobians are assembled in a mostly vectorized form, reducing repeated Python work during optimizer callbacks. The best feasible result among all starts is retained and uniformly safety-shrunk only for numerical roundoff.
